$comment: CANONICAL generator stable-name manifest (ADR-0021 D3). The single cross-port source of truth for generator stable names. Every port's generator registry is conformance-tested against this file: (1) every generator a port exposes MUST use a name listed here; (2) for each generator, the `ports` array lists exactly the ports expected to expose it (presence is checked both ways); (3) because all ports validate against this one file, a shared concept (e.g. `routes`) is spelled identically everywhere. Port ids: typescript, csharp, java, kotlin, python. `tier`: native (idiomatic per-port code) or neutral (language-neutral pages that describe the model the same way in every port; a description of the output, not a door: every generator runs when the project's generator list declares it, ADR-0034 Amendment 9). `layer`: one of model, persistence, api, client, docs, capability — the grouping an adopter SELECTS BY, gated in every port exactly as `tier` is (see README.md). `eject`: "full" (the owned copy holds the generator's emit) or an exemption with a written reason and the ruling that grants it; the top-level `eject` block carries the engine surface, the exempt non-generator emitters and the pending list (ADR-0034 Amendment 8, see README.md). Adding/renaming a generator = edit THIS file + the port registry together; the conformance gate fails otherwise.

entity.concept: Per-entity model/class — the entity module (table-backed or value object).

routes.concept: Per-entity REST endpoint surface (controllers / routes / router).

output-parser.concept: Per-template response parser: a strict parse that rejects a reply not matching the @responseRef shape, plus a tolerant lenient extract for a raw model reply, which reports per field instead of throwing on a bad reply.

render-helper.concept: Per-renderable-template render helper (typed render wrappers). BOTH template subtypes render (ADR-0052), so on csharp/java/kotlin/python this covers template.output AND template.prompt; on typescript a prompt's render handle is the separate `prompt-render` generator instead, so typescript's render-helper is template.output only. Same stable name, one concept, one per-port split — stated here because the concept line is shared and the split is not.

extractor.concept: Per-template typed extract<Name> helper: tolerant recovery of the typed response from dirty model text; throws only when a @required field is lost.

template.concept: Generic Mustache template primitive (walk + template -> files).

eject.exempt: The Mustache primitive. The template and the walk the adopter supplies are its emit logic, so the package holds none to hand over.

prisma-schema.concept: A Prisma schema (schema.prisma) for the model's tables, with the CHECK constraints Prisma cannot declare in a companion SQL file.
prisma-schema.note: TYPESCRIPT ONLY by design (#479): Prisma is a TypeScript ORM, and the generator is a reference helper (ADR-0034 Amendment 3) writing a schema that imports nothing.

callable.concept: Per-entity callable wrapper for a callable source (storedProc / tableFunction); in TS it also covers the service surface wrapping the query helpers.

barrel.concept: Single index module re-exporting every generated entity module.

names.concept: Per-entity physical database name constants (table/view name, schema, column names).

prompt-render.concept: Per-template.prompt render handle over the render engine, aggregated into one module. TYPESCRIPT ONLY by design: the other four ports emit a prompt's render helper from `render-helper` (see its note) rather than a second generator.

api-docs.concept: Per-entity/template SDK API reference (generated-code API; human + agent forms).
api-docs.note: An ordinary generator, listed in the project's generator list and run by the gen command (ADR-0034 Amendment 9), in every port: `apiDocsFile()` in `generators` that `meta gen` runs (TypeScript), an `ApiDocsGenerator` entry in `codegen/Generators.cs` that `dotnet meta gen` runs (C#), `api-docs` in a target's `generators` that `metaobjects gen` runs (Python), or a `<generator>` entry that `mvn metaobjects:generate` runs (Java, Kotlin).

trace-helper.concept: Per-entity typed record<Entity>/call<Entity> trace helpers (extract + buildLlmCallRow + persist; LlmCallBase-derived entities only).
trace-helper.note: TS emits record<Entity> + call<Entity>; Java (codegen-spring) emits record<Entity> only — the Java LlmClient seam is BYO/vendor-neutral and not ported (ADR-0024). Python emits record_<entity> only (same BYO-caller rationale).

db-context.concept: Single EF Core DbContext binding every generated entity.

repository.concept: Per-entity repository seam (Java: Spring Data interface; Kotlin: an open Exposed persistence base with CRUD + patch bodies).

value-object.concept: Per-value-object Spring record with jakarta constraints (the DTO/Patch bind target for a field.object jsonb column, and a template's payload/response type).

exposed-table.concept: Kotlin Exposed table object per table-backed or view-backed entity or projection, and per view-backed report.

spring-config.concept: Spring wiring/configuration for the generated surface.

shared-model.concept: FR-023: a publisher's flattened shared-model artifact + manifest for a consumer's `meta deps sync`.

form.concept: Per-entity React form component over the generated Zod schema.

hooks.concept: Per-entity TanStack Query hooks (useEntity / useEntities / useCreate / useUpdate / useDelete).

grid.concept: Per-entity TanStack Table column definitions, from a layout.dataGrid declaration.

grid-hook.concept: Per-entity server-driven grid state hook (sort/filter/page) over the generated columns.

requirement-tests.concept: Per-requirement test stub, one per requirement.functional claim in the ledger.

report-export.concept: Per-report export module (CSV, JSON and XML writers over a served object.report's derived fields) plus one shared writer module per project; wires the ?format= branch into the report list routes. Standalone catalog generator, never implied by a library (ADR-0034 Amendment 5).

cube-model.concept: Cube data model files (model/cubes/*.yml, model/views/*.yml) exported from the reporting vocabulary.
cube-model.note: TYPESCRIPT ONLY by design (FR-044 Plan 4, reporting design R6): a reference helper (ADR-0034 Amendment 3) writing YAML that imports nothing; no other port ships an exporter.

docs.concept: Neutral per-entity / per-template Markdown documentation pages.
docs.note: Listed like any generator; writes to the `docs` target (ADR-0034 Amendment 9).

requirements.concept: The requirement ledger as documentation: requirements.md for people and requirements.toon for tools.
requirements.note: Listed like any generator; writes to the `docs` target (ADR-0034 Amendment 9). A project that declares no requirement.* node gets no file.

agent-docs.concept: Pages written for a coding agent working in the project: the schema, the UI surface and the requirements.
agent-docs.note: Listed like any generator; writes to the `docs` target (ADR-0034 Amendment 9).

metamodel-docs.concept: The reference of the built-in metamodel: every type, subtype and attribute the build registers, by provider.
metamodel-docs.note: TYPESCRIPT ONLY: it was `meta docs --metamodel` until 1.1.0 (ADR-0034 Amendment 9).

docs-site.concept: The browsable HTML site of the model: navigation, search, a page per package and per object, ER diagrams.
docs-site.note: TYPESCRIPT ONLY: it was `meta docs --site` until 1.1.0 (ADR-0034 Amendment 9).

eject.exempt: The site builder is engine: it assembles the page data the site's templates read, and what an adopter changes is those templates and the assets beside them, which `meta eject docs-site` copies into codegen/docs-site/ and the generator reads from there.

plantuml.concept: PlantUML class diagram of the object model.

html-docs.concept: Single-page HTML reference of the registered metamodel types, read from the type registry.

ai-docs.concept: JSON reference of the registered metamodel types written for an AI reader, read from the type registry.

json-schema.concept: JSON Schema that validates metadata files, read from the type registry.

mustache.concept: The pre-`template` Mustache generator, kept so a pom that names its class keeps building.

eject.exempt: Deprecated in favour of `template` (ADR-0021 D4) and kept only so existing poms build. A deprecated generator is not handed over.

eject.$comment: The eject contract (ADR-0034 Amendment 8), asserted in every port by its eject-contract test. `engineSurface.<port>`: `codegenPackages` are the namespaces that hold generators and their emit code; `engine` lists the members of those namespaces an owned copy may still import (the generator base and runner, model questions, naming and type-mapping tables). Anything else inside `codegenPackages` writes output and must be handed over with the generator. Everything outside `codegenPackages` (loader, metamodel, runtime, render) is core and may be imported freely. `exemptEmitters`: code that writes into an adopter's repository but is not a generator, ruled out of eject with a reason. `pending`: every place the contract does not hold yet, by generator, port, assertion (census, completeness or depth) and gap number; a depth entry lists in `outside` the modules its owned copy still imports from outside the engine surface. A port's test fails when a pending entry passes, and when a gap appears that is not listed. 1.1.0 does not ship with a non-empty pending list: the release scripts and the publish workflows refuse a version with no prerelease suffix while eject.pending holds an entry (scripts/eject-release-gate.mjs).

exemptEmitters.name: docs-site builders
exemptEmitters.exempt: The builder is engine: what an adopter changes is the site's templates and assets, which `meta eject docs-site` copies into the project (codegen/docs-site/). The builders assemble the page data the templates read.
exemptEmitters.ruling: ADR-0034 Amendment 8, ruling 3, as Amendment 9 restates it
